name: dromaios
description: An in-browser emulation platform for exploring how computers work.

scripts.clean: node --input-type=module -e "import { rmSync } from 'node:fs'; for (const path of ['dist', 'src/machines/generated', 'src/components/cpus/generated', 'src/components/cpus/semantics/generated', 'src/components/devices/generated']) rmSync(path, { recursive: true, force: true });"
scripts.generate: npm run generate:cpus && npm run generate:devices && npm run generate:machines
scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run check:src && tsc
scripts.build:site: npm run generate && node --input-type=module -e "import { rmSync } from 'node:fs'; rmSync('dist/site', { recursive: true, force: true });" && tsc --project site/tsconfig.json && uv run --project site --locked python site/build.py
scripts.test:site: npm run generate && tsc --project site/tsconfig.json --noEmit && uv run --project site --locked python -m unittest discover -s site -p "test_*.py"
